timeseriesId.description: A unique identifier associated with this timeseries.

latest.description: The most recent timeseries entry, only shown if within the last week, and a historic range has not been requested. Code must be resilient if `latest` is omitted from a timeseries.

x-provenance.note: Derived by API Evangelist from Newcastle University's own published Urban Observatory OpenAPI. Not published by the institution in this form.
